summary: Alpha Protocol entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Alpha Protocol

emulation.notes: Use native Windows PC release; console routes only for comparison.

primary.why: Alpha Protocol is again available on PC, and the current PC release gives the best capture route for Obsidian's spy RPG while avoiding reliance on old delisted copies.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam or GOG PC release. Record storefront, build, licensed-music/patch state, controller/mouse setup, difficulty, character build, mission order, reputation/choices, endings, and any compatibility fixes.

secondary.why: PC is the capture/settings route and current availability route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront/build and licensed-music/patch state because availability changed over time.
